motion-gestures.title: Motion · Gesture animation
motion-gestures.finding: Hover, press, focus and drag APIs support feedback on real controls. Specific timings and visual treatments in this study are WDA proposals.

motion-access.title: Motion · Accessibility
motion-access.finding: Reduced-motion policy can govern transforms and custom media behavior. The app must also stop its own shaders and decorative video.

shader.title: Three.js · ShaderMaterial
shader.finding: A custom GLSL material can receive time and resolution uniforms. This supports a proposed procedural light field for Afterglow.

r3f.title: React Three Fiber · Scaling performance
r3f.finding: On-demand rendering and explicit invalidation support scenes that stop when still. Reuse geometry and materials; measure the actual mobile workload.

veo.title: Google · Video generation
veo.finding: Image-directed video is a motion-study option. Use a currently supported Veo endpoint at production time; these briefs intentionally do not pin a preview model. A generated clip is not editable 3D geometry.

visibility.title: MDN · Page Visibility API
visibility.finding: Document visibility changes let the application suspend decorative media when the page is hidden. Resume from state rather than counting background frames.

pause.title: W3C · Pause, Stop, Hide
pause.finding: Automatically moving content lasting more than five seconds alongside other content needs a way to pause, stop or hide it. This proposal uses short ambient introductions that settle.

drag-alternative.title: W3C · Dragging movements
drag-alternative.finding: Dragging needs a single-pointer alternative. Petal retains tap-select and tap-target controls as well as keyboard input.
